note: 6 extra hook formulas after Kallaway's hook method (Context + Lean + Snapback, triple alignment, loops), added by YouTube-Kit next to the 21 upstream formulas in hooks.json. Same fields as hooks.json. The upstream hookscore.py does not read this file; tools/kallaway_score.py reads both.
rules: Kallaway: Context + Lean + Snapback. Viewer must know topic in 1 sec, lean in by 3 sec, get snapped back by 5 sec.
Kallaway: Triple Alignment. Text on screen + audio + visual must all say the same thing.
Kallaway: Desire > Info. Lead with desired outcome tied to a relatable character, not secret info.

hooks.name: Kallaway Triple Hook
hooks.shape: Context + Lean + Contrarian Snapback. State topic, make them lean in, then snap expectation opposite. God-tier formula.
hooks.example: This is how to write a hook. Everyone thinks you need a shocking first line. It's actually the third line that makes people stay.
hooks.fails_when: Fails if you stay on one expectation. No snapback = no tension. Must have context in 1 sec, lean by 3 sec, snap by 5 sec.

hooks.name: Kallaway Desire Hook
hooks.shape: Lead with desired outcome tied to relatable character, not secret info. Identity Callout + Desire Frame + Proof Anchor.
hooks.example: Here's how Tony went from 200 followers to 20,000 in 6 weeks, even though he only posts on his phone.
hooks.fails_when: Fails if you lead with info ('3 hacks') instead of outcome. Needs a name + specific outcome + proof.

hooks.name: Kallaway 6 Power Words
hooks.shape: Subject Clarity + Action + Objective/State Change + Contrast + 2 Intrigue words. From -> To jump creates curiosity.
hooks.example: If I had to grow from 0 to 100K subs on YouTube, here's how I'd do it.
hooks.fails_when: Fails if no clear from -> to. Vague objective kills it.

hooks.name: Kallaway Triple Alignment
hooks.shape: Text on screen + audio + visual all say SAME thing. For scoring: hook must be understandable with sound off AND eyes closed.
hooks.example: [visual: full-size floor plan taped on the floor, on-screen text 'Lifesize floor plans'] I built lifesize floor plans.
hooks.fails_when: Fails if text says one thing, audio says another, visual shows a third. Misalignment = scroll.

hooks.name: Kallaway Triple Loop / Rehook
hooks.shape: Hook Loop (0-5s) + Intensifier Loop (by 15s) + Rehook Loop (at 30s). Open new loop before last closes.
hooks.example: That hook got 14M views. But the second half is why it kept them - and most creators miss it. I'll show you at 0:30.
hooks.fails_when: Fails if you close all loops early. No open loop = no reason to stay.

hooks.name: Kallaway Dopamine / Headfake
hooks.shape: Stakes + Big Question + Headfake + Rehook. Lead them to expect A, deliver B, restart loop. Casino psychology.
hooks.example: He was about to sell his house to fund his channel. Did he hit 10K? The answer is not what you think.
hooks.fails_when: Fails if headfake is random. It must be a plausible expectation, then a real twist. In YouTube-Kit both the expectation and the twist must be in facts.md.
